messages:
tanya_cs: Heads-up: small customer (Nimbus) going live tonight. Need a compact handoff checklist for SE + PM focusing on prefilling, streaming fallbacks, and renewal signal capture. 10 lines max pls.
oliver_platform: I'll provide a terse ops checklist. Preference: cheap defaults that reduce visible cold-starts.
ken_sre: Key ops notes: warm-pools for heavy tenants; client jitter for many small ones. Add a fast circuit-breaker and a 24h activity probe for renewal signals.
lina_se: From demos: show a quick shimmer placeholder then stream partials asap. Also include copy for the fallback screen.
oliver_platform: Ops checklist (copy this to SEs):
```
- Toggle tenant prefill on consent
- Start client jitter 0-1500ms by default
- Warm-pool for paid tenants (ttl=75s)
- Edge cache TTL=45s for static prompts
- Stream partials every 150ms if available
- Tag `renewal_risk` when 24h active tokens < 5% baseline
- Circuit-breaker: 4 prefill fails -> disable prefill for 10m
- Post-go-live: send 24h health ping + 1Q NPS (1-5)
```
ops-bot: ops-bot: [auto] Warm-pool for tenant NIM-77 scheduled by oliver_platform
tanya_cs: Perfect. Lina, can you paste the banner/fallback copy you mentioned?
lina_se: Copy: "Starting your assistant... if this takes more than a sec we'll continue with partial responses." Fallback: "Slow start detected continuing with partial replies. Try refreshing if issues persist."
ken_sre: Also add to PM checklist: model-pin confirmed, quotas set (+30%), and rollback route validated.
tanya_cs: Thanks all. I'll bundle into a one-pager and post in #cs-resources. tagging @oliver_platform for final sign-off. :shipit:
